'''Abbas Anvari''' ({{langx|fa|عباس انواری}}{{lrm}}; 6 March 1944 – 12 July 2025) was an Iranian academic who was a professor of [[physics]]. 

==Life and career==
Born on 6 March 1944,<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 July 2025 |title=عباس انواری |url=https://www.cgie.org.ir/popup/fa/system/contentprint/221278 |access-date=13 July 2025 |website=The Centre for the Great Islamic Encyclopaedia}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=12 July 2025 |title=دکتر عباس انواری درگذشت |url=https://noandish.com/fa/news/200139/%D8%AF%DA%A9%D8%AA%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B1%DB%8C-%D8%AF%D8%B1%DA%AF%D8%B0%D8%B4%D8%AA |access-date=13 July 2025 |website=fa |language=fa}}</ref> he earned a Ph.D. in physics from [[Chalmers University of Technology]] in [[Gothenburg]], Sweden. Anvari served as the chancellor of [[Sharif University of Technology]] in [[Tehran]], Iran for two terms: 1980–1982 and 1985–1989.<ref>{{cite web |title=Former Presidents |url=http://www.sharif.ir/web/en/13 |publisher=Sharif University |accessdate=19 September 2012 |archive-date=19 April 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170419102303/http://www.sharif.ir/web/en/13 |url-status=dead }}</ref> He died on 12 July 2025, at the age of 81.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=12 July 2025 |title=عباس انواری، رئیس اسبق دانشگاه صنعتی شریف درگذشت |url=https://www.entekhab.ir/fa/news/874785/%D8%B9%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B1%DB%8C-%D8%B1%D8%A6%DB%8C%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%A8%D9%82-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B4%DA%AF%D8%A7%D9%87-%D8%B5%D9%86%D8%B9%D8%AA%DB%8C-%D8%B4%D8%B1%DB%8C%D9%81-%D8%AF%D8%B1%DA%AF%D8%B0%D8%B4%D8%AA |access-date=13 July 2025 |website=fa |language=fa}}</ref>
